newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes broadly flat against dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes broadly flat against dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat against the dollar in slow trade at 474.00/475.25 per dollar, traders said.
On Thursday the unit closed at 474.00/475.00 per dollar.
"It was a very quiet session. The Central Bank sold hardly any dollars -- there just wasn't the demand," said one trader.

Venezuela's Central Bank is by far the single largest supplier of dollars to Venezuela's foreign exchange market. By law, state-owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PdVSA) must remit all of its dollar earnings to the bank.
